goal: Remaster all six Monster Breeding Grounds rooms with crisp connected terrain, nesting details, distinct landmarks, local light and restrained animation/ambience while preserving gameplay and saves.

rooms.landmark: entrance, worn stair approach and discarded shells
guard bedding and existing prisoner alcove
brood nests and existing locked passage

completed_steps: Connected rock walls with facets, cracks and shaded faces
Quiet packed earth, damp hollows, gravel and worn approach
Nests, eggshells, shed scales, straw, bones and claw marks
Authored landmarks in all six rooms
Cool fungi lights and warm lamps integrated with existing occlusion/fog rules
Scene-time drips/ripples, spores and grit plus a quiet licensed cave ambience loop

implementation.terrain: One cached 416x384 native texture; shared retro palette and opaque pixels; world-aligned procedural rock/soil across matching authored overlaps. Hand-authored native-pixel details clip to appropriate terrain and avoid event cells.
implementation.audio: Full 94.31-second CC0 Loopable Dungeon Ambience by JaggedStone, converted to 22050-Hz stereo PCM. One looping voice, short fade-in, master Sound/Volume, pause/menu/map/focus gates, effect ducking and disposal on biome exit.
implementation.scope: Explicit maps 59,60,65,66,105,106; other environment-7 regions are excluded.

coverage: secret wall/floor alias equivalence including lighting
fog masks for terrain, particles and light
real audio loading and pause/resume/mute/volume/exit lifecycle
default gameplay presentation and all six native views
verification.personal_files: Save, journal and profile hashes unchanged; see personal-unchanged.json

review.simplicity: Uses the existing WorldRenderer partial-file pattern, shared noise and palette, existing light compositor and GameAudio lifecycle. One cached texture and one ambient voice; no new scene framework, gameplay state or save fields. Scoped production diff and new tests reviewed.
review.visual: All six native views inspected, with default-presentation captures; floor dithering, rock facets, prisoner bedding and lamp placement refined before final checks.
review.limits: Original authored border-layout differences are preserved. Continuity is compared where neighboring authored terrain matches. User visual review remains the next step.
